Develop and execute a global manufacturing strategy aligned with growth objectives, customer demand, operational requirements, and long-term business plans. Support the successful introduction of new products, manufacturing processes, and production capacity. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, product quality, and manufacturing performance. Standardize manufacturing systems, performance metrics, governance processes, and operational best practices across the global manufacturing organization. Improve cost competitiveness, asset utilization, productivity, and margin performance while maintaining exceptional levels of quality, reliability, and customer service. Build, develop, and retain a world-class manufacturing leadership team while strengthening organizational capability, succession planning, and talent development initiatives. Collaborative leader with exceptional communication skills, a data-driven decision-making approach, and the ability to successfully lead change in complex, growth-oriented environments. review_candidates.description: Job Description Sr Production Engineer (CF34/CFM56) Winnipeg, MB Canada Build an Aviation Career You’re Proud Of At StandardAero, we use our ingenuity and know-how to find solutions for the simple to the most complex challenges in aviation. Together, we get the job done and done well. Our stability, resources, and respectful culture supports you in building a solid career with a great team you can count on day in and day out for the long term. As a Sr Product Engineer, you’llprovide technical engineering support to the operations team, ensure adherence to flight and product safety standards, and drive continuous improvement to enhance quality, reliability, and turnaround time. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure product safety, reliability, and compliance while improving production efficiency and quality. What You’ll Do Provide day-to-day engineering support to production for assigned products and processes. Liaises with manufacturers in order to resolve technical problems. Assist in developing matrix routings to manage the flow of material throughout production processes. Develop, document, and maintain procedures, work instructions, and process documentation. Provide technical guidance and process-related training to production and support personnel. Analyze production and repair processes to improve quality, efficiency, and turnaround time with supporting cost analysis. Perform data analysis in order to establish metrics. Investigate equipment/tooling and process deficiencies and initiate corrective actions to reduce variation and improve reliability. Develop and implement new product repair processes based on engineering data, including planning and conducting repair trials. Perform cost-benefit analyses for new equipment, tooling, or technology that supports product and process improvements. Coordinate with Engineering, Operations, and vendors to implement new repairs, processes, and product improvements while maintaining compliance with safety and regulatory requirements. Carries out special projects as assigned. Basic Qualifications University degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience. Minimum of 8 years of experience with manufacturing methods, shop equipment, and machining processes, demonstrated through hands-on work or completed projects. Experience demonstrating planning, organizational, analytical, leadership, decision-making, and oral and written communication skills, measurable by successful project completion, team management, or prior performance evaluations. Experience with precision measuring instruments, measurable by prior to use inspections, calibrations, or quality control tasks. Working knowledge of PCs in the company operating system environment and production management systems. Strong analytical and root cause problem-solving skills. Ability to read, understand, and interpret blueprints, demonstrated by successful completion of assigned manufacturing, repair, or maintenance tasks. Ability to read and understand company instructions, processes, and OEM manuals. Where applicable, registration with the relevant regulatory body or professional association is required. Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation, reporting, and training. Desired Skills Knowledge of aerospace materials, manufacturing process and repair methodologies is an asset. Project management experience in engineering or manufacturing environments. Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, vendors, and suppliers Knowledge of continuous improvement or lean manufacturing methodologies. Benefits That Make Life Better Comprehensive Healthcare Company pension plan with 100% company match; up to 5% vested (Canada) Paid Time Off starting on day one Bonus opportunities Health- & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts Short- & Long-Term Disability Learning & Training opportunities #CES About Us Raising the Standard of Excellence since 1911 With over a century of proven excellence, StandardAero has become an industry leader in MRO services and customized solutions in the aerospace field. Our shared values and learning-based culture inspire our team to exceed their potential and power our customers’ missions worldwide.
